spec.description:
Spring Boot Application Observability is a centralized monitoring and analytics platform designed to provide real-time visibility into application performance, infrastructure health, and operational metrics. By integrating Spring Boot Actuator, Prometheus, and Grafana, the platform enables administrators and engineering teams to monitor system behavior, track key performance indicators, detect anomalies, and proactively resolve issues.

The dashboard delivers comprehensive insights into:

Application availability and uptime
Request throughput and response times
Error rates and exception tracking
JVM memory and CPU utilization
Database connection pool statistics
Thread performance and resource consumption
Infrastructure and container health metrics
Real-time alerting and operational status

This observability solution empowers administrators with data-driven decision-making capabilities, ensuring high availability, reliability, and optimal performance across the Spring Boot application ecosystem.
spec.title: Spring Boot Application Observability
